title: A unified and more powerful timeline for software spaces in Jira
description: We’re upgrading the Jira timeline to help you plan and track work with more clarity. This update brings a consistent experience, making it easier to manage everything from high-level epics to individual subtasks in one view. You can now view and manage all work items, including subtasks, directly on your timeline.
